import re

def parse(lines):
    banner_re = re.compile(r'^LSNRCTL for (?P<platform>.+?): Version (?P<version>\S+)(?: - (?P<edition>.+?))? on (?P<date>.+?)\s*$')
    conn_re = re.compile(r'^Connecting to (?P<value>.+?)\s*$')
    kv_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<key>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s{2,}(?P<value>\S.*?)\s*$')
    svc_re = re.compile(r'^Service "(?P<service>[^"]*)" has (?P<n>\d+) instance\(s\)\.\s*$')
    inst_re = re.compile(r'^\s+Instance "(?P<inst>[^"]*)", status (?P<status>\S+), has (?P<h>\d+) handler\(s\) for this service\.*\s*$')
    ep_re = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<desc>\(.*\))\s*$')
    msg_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<key>(?:TNS|Linux Error|ORA)[- ]?[\w ]*?):\s*(?P<value>.*?)\s*$')
    skip_re = re.compile(r'^(?:Copyright .*|STATUS of the LISTENER|-+|Listening Endpoints Summary\.*|Services Summary\.*)\s*$')
    header = {}
    header_lines = []
    status = {}
    status_lines = []
    endpoints = []
    ep_lines = []
    services = []
    svc_lines = []
    instances = []
    inst_lines = []
    result = {}
    result_lines = []
    skip = []
    state = None
    cur_svc = ''
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        s = raw.rstrip()
        if not s.strip():
            continue
        m = banner_re.match(s)
        if m:
            header['Platform'] = m.group('platform')
            header['Version'] = m.group('version')
            if m.group('edition'):
                header['Edition'] = m.group('edition')
            header['Date'] = m.group('date')
            header_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if skip_re.match(s.strip()):
            t = s.strip()
            if t.startswith('Listening Endpoints'):
                state = 'ep'
            elif t.startswith('Services Summary'):
                state = 'svc'
            elif t.startswith('STATUS of'):
                state = None
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = conn_re.match(s)
        if m:
            header['Connecting to'] = m.group('value')
            header_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = svc_re.match(s)
        if m:
            state = 'svc'
            cur_svc = m.group('service')
            services.append({'Service': cur_svc, 'Instances': int(m.group('n'))})
            svc_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = inst_re.match(s)
        if m:
            instances.append({'Service': cur_svc, 'Instance': m.group('inst'), 'Status': m.group('status'), 'Handlers': int(m.group('h'))})
            inst_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = ep_re.match(s)
        if m and state == 'ep':
            desc = m.group('desc')
            params = {}
            for k, v in re.findall(r'\((\w+)=([^()]*)\)', desc):
                if k.upper() not in params:
                    params[k.upper()] = v
            endpoints.append({'Description': desc, 'PROTOCOL': params.get('PROTOCOL', ''), 'HOST': params.get('HOST', ''), 'PORT': params.get('PORT', ''), 'KEY': params.get('KEY', '')})
            ep_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if s.startswith('The command completed'):
            result['Result'] = s.strip()
            result_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = msg_re.match(s)
        if m:
            result[m.group('key')] = m.group('value')
            result_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = kv_re.match(s)
        if m and state is None:
            status[m.group('key')] = m.group('value')
            status_lines.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if header:
        blocks.append({'name': 'banner', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': header_lines, 'records': [header]})
    if status:
        blocks.append({'name': 'listener_status', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': status_lines, 'records': [status]})
    if endpoints:
        blocks.append({'name': 'endpoints', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ep_lines, 'records': endpoints})
    if services:
        blocks.append({'name': 'services', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': svc_lines, 'records': services})
    if instances:
        blocks.append({'name': 'service_instances', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': inst_lines, 'records': instances})
    if result:
        blocks.append({'name': 'result', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': result_lines, 'records': [result]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
